Sleepa Design Kit

FoundationsShellPlayer rows & matchupSleepa HuddleStart / SitSleepa ZoneSleepa IntelOverlays

Every component below is real markup from Sleepa's own renderers, styled by the real stylesheet copied from index.html, shown in dark and light side by side at its real width (phone 375px or desktop 1280px, scaled to fit). Photos are placeholders and managers' names are fictional. Values: TOKENS.css. Rules and component anatomy: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md. Trading cards: ../cards/handoff/CARDS.md. Start / Sit: ../start-sit/START-SIT.md. Static: no data fetching, no storage; fonts load from Google Fonts (falls back to system UI offline).
